author: Jo Anne Fleming
text: If you are using your phone uninstall then reinstall the app each time you start a new sensor.  That may help.

author: Dawne Pitre
text: I've had a number of wonky sensors recently.  They were consistently reading much lower than my fingersticks. Lower to the point that if I believed the readings I should have been going to the hospital lows - but my fingersticks were perfectly fine.  Ended up having to remove and replace those sensors
